twin.schema_manager

Unified Schema Management for Virtual Twin System

This module provides a single source of truth for all database schema operations, ensuring consistency between SQLModel and raw SQL table definitions.

Attributes

logger

parser

Classes

SchemaManager

Central manager for all database schema operations.

Module Contents

twin.schema_manager.logger
class twin.schema_manager.SchemaManager(db_path: str | None = None)

Central manager for all database schema operations.

Ensures consistency between: - SQLModel table definitions (MES tables) - Raw SQL table definitions (Twin tables) - Ontology YAML specifications - Database indices and constraints

Initialize the schema manager.

Parameters:

db_path – Path to the SQLite database. If None, uses default.

Get the complete set of all managed tables.

Returns:

Set of all table names managed by the system

verify_schema() → Dict[str, Any]

Verify the database schema against expected definitions.

Returns:

  • missing_tables: Tables that should exist but don’t

  • extra_tables: Tables that exist but aren’t documented

  • schema_version: Current schema version

  • is_valid: Boolean indicating if schema is valid

Return type:

Dictionary with verification results including
